_help: Stations the directory files under the wrong country or place, or without a genre they should have. Matched by name (case does not matter; "CHUO" also catches "CHUO 89.1 FM"). `country` is the real two-letter code; `state` the real place, if known; `onlyIn` limits the fix to stations the directory files under that country; `addTags` adds genres. Keep this in step with src/data/corrections.ts, which does the same job for the live fallback.
